title: Project Gantt with nested phases and dependencies
intent: Show a small project plan as phase header lanes with indented task lanes, progress fills, a milestone, a status-date rule, and right-angle finish-to-start dependency arrows, with every task reachable by keyboard.
features: band lanes over a UTC time scale
phase summary lanes with indented child lanes

ai.create: Create a responsive Gantt chart from typed project tasks with phase, dates, progress, and finish-to-start predecessors: phase header lanes followed by indented task lanes on a band scale, UTC time, progress fills, a milestone, a status-date rule, and right-angle dependency arrows that stay out of keyboard focus.
ai.maintain: Add a task and a predecessor to one phase without changing lane order rules, breaking the phase roll-up, adding focus stops for connectors, or routing any dependency segment diagonally.
